name: artifactsend
description: Share documents, pages and data rooms as tracked links from ChatGPT, then ask who read them.

interface.shortDescription: Share docs, see who read them
interface.longDescription:
ArtifactSend turns what you make in ChatGPT into a link that tells you who read it. Ask ChatGPT to share a page, a memo, a deck, or a PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel file, and you get one link. You choose the door: open, email, a 6-digit email code, Google sign-in, or only certain emails or company domains. You can make one link per person and set an expiry.

Later, ask "who read it?" ChatGPT answers from the real reading data: who opened it, when, how long they spent on each page, slide or section, how far they got, and what they asked. Fix something and say "put the new version behind the same link", and readers see the update at the link they already have.

Data rooms put many documents behind one link and one door, with folders, an NDA readers accept first, and a watermark with each reader's email. You see who opened which document.

Someone sent you an ArtifactSend link? Paste it and ChatGPT can read it with you, under the sender's rules, and draft a reply you approve.

Made by Vela Partners.
capabilities: Share a page, memo, deck or Office file as a tracked link
Make one link per person with an email check
See who read it, for how long and how far
Update a document behind the same link
Make a data room with an NDA and watermark
Read a link someone shared with you
defaultPrompt: Share this memo with ArtifactSend and make readers confirm their email
Who read the deck I sent last week?
Make a data room for our seed round with an NDA

positive.description: Share a short memo as a tracked link with an email gate
positive.prompt: Write a three-paragraph investor update for Northwind and share it with ArtifactSend. Readers must confirm their email.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the update, calls send_artifact with the full text and access verified, and returns an artifactsend.com/d/ link.

positive.description: Ask who read a shared document
positive.prompt: Who read the documents I shared with ArtifactSend, and for how long?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the user's links and reports each reader, when they opened it, time spent and how far they read, using only the returned data.

positive.description: Make a personal link for one reader
positive.prompt: Make a separate ArtifactSend link of my latest document just for dana@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the latest link and calls link_for_person for dana@example.com, returning a new link for that person only.

positive.description: Build a data room with an NDA and watermark
positive.prompt: Put my ArtifactSend documents into a data room called Acme Seed, with a short NDA and a watermark.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the NDA text, then calls make_data_room with the links, the NDA and watermark true, and returns one room link.

positive.description: See recent reader activity across all links
positive.prompt: What happened on my ArtifactSend links this week?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls recent_activity and summarizes opens, readers and questions from the returned data, without inventing readers.

negative.description: General writing with no sharing intent

negative.prompt: Upload this file to my Google Drive and share it with my team.

publication.release_notes: First release: tracked links, reading reports, personal links, data rooms and reading shared links.
